rows.label: fev02_290_125_msg0006
rows.name: Boss, you were pretty good, mo.

rows.label: fev02_290_125_msg0007
rows.name:
Just what I'd expect from a salvager,
mo.

rows.label: fev02_290_125_msg0009
rows.name:
Your salvaging experience
must be coming in handy!

rows.label: fev02_290_125_msg0010
rows.name:
I appreciate the compliments, but
we should get going to rescue Nia.

rows.label: fev02_290_125_msg0011
rows.name: Boss, are you bad at games, mo?

rows.label: fev02_290_125_msg0012
rows.name:
H-hey, give me a break... It was my
first attempt, what do you expect?

rows.label: fev02_290_125_msg0013
rows.name:
You'll definitely get better if you
keep playing, mo.

rows.label: fev02_290_125_msg0014
rows.name:
L-let's just concentrate
on Nia right now.

rows.label: fev02_290_125_msg0001
rows.name:
How do we get to that
Divine Beast battleship
where they're keeping Nia?

rows.label: fev02_290_125_msg0002
rows.name:
Go all the way up the stairs, then
cross the bridge and pass through the
gate to reach Gareguro Hill, mo.

rows.label: fev02_290_125_msg0003
rows.name:
Will we have trouble with the
Superbian Empire's guards?

rows.label: fev02_290_125_msg0004
rows.name:
The area around the Superbian base is
heavily guarded, but Gareguro Hill
should be fine, mo.

rows.label: fev02_290_125_msg0005
rows.name: Alright, let's aim for there first!

rows.label: fev02_290_125_msg0015
rows.name: Let's give it our all, mo!

rows.label: fev02_290_125_msg0016
rows.name:
Luckily, the Cloud Sea seems to
be ebbing now. We should aim for
the root Homura mentioned.

rows.label: fev02_290_125_msg0017
rows.name:
Those roots stretched out just beyond
Gareguro Hill, mo.
